action.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.type='Revenue' THEN g.credit - g.debit WHEN a.type='Expense' THEN -(g.debit - g.credit) ELSE 0 END) AS net_income FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON g.account_id = a.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND g.period = '2026-04' AND a.type IN ('Revenue','Expense')
